note: Family campground near Wolcottville on 170-acre Atwood Lake (10 mph), one of the iCampIndiana group, with a sandy beach and piers; overnight and seasonal sites. --Claude
summary: $40 confirmed; season Apr 15-Oct 15, operator booking, 219 sites from the map, facilities added; note cleaned. Seasonal share can't be read; shore-loop re-audit lead; pin at the office.
flags: SEASONAL / long-stay tests: site says 'Overnight Camping and Seasonal Sites Available!' and 'We have plenty of weekend camping sites'; nightly $40, weekly $240, monthly $595 plus metered electric, seasonal 'starting at only $2,495' with 'Come pick your site now for the 2027 Season!!'. The map numbers about 219 sites without marking which are seasonal, and no page gives the split, so I cannot say it is mostly seasonal; reviews name 'Friendly seasonal campers who ensure activities are scheduled' (4 years ago). A borderline read: real nightly business on the site, unknown share. Worth a call if it matters: 260-854-3079.
GATE: rate posted ($40 W/E, under the $50 gate; $50 with holiday surcharge). Own booking form. Google 4.0/113. gateways.py: none within 40 km. Website and phone 260-854-3079 live.

REVIEWS: top review, edited a month ago: 'New new management has come, great folks, unfortunately, owner still a penny pinching miser... Facilities are still declining'. 4 years ago: 'The shower houses are in need of major updating and repair'; 'The roads are in desperate need of maintenan[ce]'. Mixed, not 'very poor'.

WATER LEAD: operator: 'Pavilion next to beach, on the lake'; a 2-year-old review had 'a sweet spot by the lake'. Map and NAIP: the northern loop (sites 18, 19, 24, 31, 32) ends at the shore road; rigs visible about 25 m behind the shoreline, with the road and a strip of pier parking between, open sky over it. Stored 'not waterfront' deserves a re-audit for those few sites only; most of the ~219 are 300-900 m back in the trees. Not changed.

PIN: 41.5297,-85.4110 is at the office and gate on the east side, about 275 m from the middle of the sites and about 900 m from the northern loop. Loops are visible under trees; if a move is wanted, about 41.5316,-85.4133.

POLICY: rule 18 says 'WE DON'T GIVE REFUNDS ON CAMPING FEES FOR ANY REASON' while the reservation page allows a refund less $25 at 8+ days. 'All visitors must register' and pay $5/$8 ($7/$10 holidays). Rates are 'based on a family of 2 adults and dependent children'. Golf carts need a $20 registration. ATVs and similar banned. Nothing that bears on EKKO.
SITE LENGTH unposted; the form asks 'Camper Length'. 'Nice size lots' (review, 4 years). Good Sam false stored, derived; left. Amps unposted, so electric not written.
